name: Ritchie Wong
title: Psychologist
description: Ritchie is a Psychologist and EMDR Practitioner in Melbourne who has been working with people of all ages from diverse cultural backgrounds who present with various issues at different stages of their lives. Ritchie incorporates various evidence-based treatments including EMDR therapy, Cognitive Behavioural Therapy, Mindfulness, Relaxation, Hypnosis and Ego State Therapy to ensure that clients obtain a carefully-tailored experience with the best possible outcomes. He is experienced at dealing with a range of mental health issues but has a particular interest in the treatment of PTSD, childhood trauma, abuse and long-standing chronic depression and anxiety.
specialties: PTSD, Complex Trauma, earlier-life (childhood) trauma and abuse.

name: Dr Fernanda Barros
title: Psychologist
description: As a practitioner her approach is client focused utilising a range of evidence based methods including schema therapy and existential phenomenology.
specialties: Coping skills, Identity, Cross-culture, Parenting, Interpersonal relationships, Couples, Adolescents, Families, Children

name: Carly Dober
title: Psychologist
description: As part of the process, I supports clients in understanding and responding to emotions, developing assertiveness to strengthen boundaries, understanding trauma and how this impacts behaviours and functioning, and unpacking and challenging gender stereotypes.
specialties:
Trauma, Eating disorder, Sexual health, work with young people (ages 10+) and adults (18-65 years).
Utilise EMDR, DBT, ACT, CBT, Nature therapy, and yoga for trauma with clients, and encourage green and social prescribing whenever possible.

name: Shelley Amity
title: Psychologist
description: Hello I'm a mindful registered psychologist with a wealth of clinical experience and has specialised in EMDR Therapy for Trauma, PTSD, Anxiety, Depression, Grief & Loss and more. Aiming to help adults from all walks of life to overcome psychological distress and trauma, develop essential coping skills and step-by-step strategies, to achieve a meaningful, happier, and healthier live.
specialties:
“Be yourself, everything else is taken”, Oscar Wild.
I encourage each client to identify their uniqueness and being unafraid to express their individuality to create an independent and meaningful life.
Overall, I have extensive clinical experience working with a diverse client group with complex presentation, such as victims of trauma in the context of my previous role at the Trauma Centre of Aust

name: Kaveh Kawa Bevrani
title: Counsellor, Social Worker
description: Kawa / Kaveh is a compassionate mental health clinician with over seven years’ experience supporting individuals through anxiety, depression, trauma, and life challenges. Kawa works with people experiencing a wide range of difficulties, including emotional overwhelm, relationship struggles, low self-esteem, the effects of past trauma, and ongoing stress. He has particular expertise in working with complex and developmental trauma, including experiences of childhood abuse or neglect, as well as sexual assault, domestic violence, and alcohol and other drug (AOD) concerns. His work is grounded in attachment-informed, client-centred, and evidence-based approaches, drawing on therapies such as EMDR, Schema Therapy, ACT, DBT, MBT, Ego-State Therapy, and CBT.
specialties: Trauma-focused therapy, attachment-informed practice, personality disorders, parenting, and a diverse range of therapy modalities including psychodynamic, CBT, DBT, IFS, IPT, ACT, schema therapy, and polyvagal theory.

name: Alyona Cerfontyne
title: Sex Therapist
description: Professional sex therapist helping couples and individuals navigate their sexuality and sexual health concerns.
specialties: Couples intimacy, sexual anxiety, decreased sexual interest, men's sexuality, sexual trauma

name: Rachel O'Meara
title: Psychologist
description: With experience in Neurodevelopmental Disorders, Depressive Disorders, Anxiety Disorders, Trauma and Stressor Related Disorders, family violence and physical disabilities, brings a comprehensive approach to her practice. Rachel draws upon a range of evidence-based therapeutic interventions including Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) and is fully trained in Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR).
specialties: Neurodevelopmental Disorders, Depressive Disorders, Anxiety Disorders, Trauma and Stressor Related Disorders, family violence and physical disabilities.

name: Lital Fee
title: Psychotherapist
description: Lital is a qualified counsellor with extensive experience working with families, children and adults who have experienced trauma, family violence, depression and anxiety and mental health related issues.
specialties: Trauma, family violence, depression and anxiety and mental health related issues.

name: Kay-Sheree Spurling
title: Psychologist
description: My areas of interest are adult ADHD, ASD, substance misuse, trauma, challenging behaviour and all things anxiety. My practice is trauma informed, neuro affirming and I welcome LGBTIQ client's.
specialties: Anxiety, ADHD, ASD, Addiction, Trauma, Depression, behavioural concerns, adjustment to parenthood, workplace issues, burnout, and managing life transitions. I use interpersonal therapy, schema therapy, client focused therapy, CBT, ACT and DBT to support adolescent and adult clients.
